note: What a person saw when they looked at each GPU run's stills and frames (the founder's reviewer). A rejected product is still evaluated, so its numbers show the failure, but it gets no renders and is left off the blind page. A faulty product is evaluated and rendered so the fault can be seen, but it is not a panel bundle and is left off the blind page. Verdicts: accepted, faulty, rejected.

azure-palm-baby-doll-dress.why: run 17b (stage 2 + 4 on run 16a's FASHN stills recomposed with stage 1b QA 0.12.0: the back still's 49 px cut tie string below the hem left out; same seeds as 16b): no grey cap above the sleeves in the stills or any turntable frame; nothing hangs below the hem of either still; run 16b's see-through lower skirt with the grey leg through and ragged tips (turntable_a 32-56) and its strings (40-80) are gone; print, puff sleeves, babydoll as in runs 15 and 16b. Open, flagged, not repaired: (1) the plain cream unprinted flap swinging out at one side of the hem in turntable_b frames about 82-155 is unchanged from 16b (not seeded by the string); (2) new: a flat, hard-edged, unprinted pale rectangle at the image's left beside the hem in turntable_a frames 13-31 (fainter also at the right at about 20-28; up to ~10 cm at 28), partly detached at 16-20, fully detached from the skirt at frame 30 (gap up to 18 px at row 520, 30 px at row 527) and gone in one frame at 31 (a local 41-51 px jump; no global flicker); both are fitted as a wider hem (hem girth 157.7 cm against run 15's 149.5); (3) 2 vertices 3.2 mm from the mannequin (clearance 4 mm); (4) the grey back-shoulder patch in AU 8 from the side and the straight side view; (5) the motion clip draws a sleeveless strappy dress (not used). Accepted pending founder review: 17b over 16b is a judgement call between two different visible defects (16b: the grey leg through a see-through lower skirt in turntable_a 32-56 plus strings; 17b: the floating flat panel in 13-31); neither is panel-clean; founder to choose. For 17b: chest -0.50 cm, flat-lay -1.00 cm, holdout IoU level; against: hem girth +1.8 cm, skirt Chamfer 1.13 against 1.06. Looked at by the evaluating agent, not yet by the founder

crimson-wildflower-maxi-skirt.why: kept for evaluation, not for the panel: waistband and print right, but NOT at the hips (the founder: "see the hips"): in both stage 1b stills the grey mannequin hip shows outside the skirt at the sides, and in the stage 2 frames the skirt opens into a wedge-shaped slit at the side with the grey leg showing. Stage 1b QA failed the front only (silhouette 0.864) and was overridden

rosewater-blouse.why: FASHN stills torn (patches of print with the mannequin showing through, the back a pale blotchy shirt); stage 2 frames contain black panels on the back and side. Stage 2 ran anyway because --accept-failed-dress overrides the silhouette and fidelity failures

rosewater-palazzo-pants.why: FASHN drew a closed skirt in both views (legs merged in 259 of 259 rows); the type gate stopped it before stage 2. The shop photo's legs are so wide they read as a skirt

woodstock-wanderer-knit-cardi.why: front still a shrunken bolero (sleeves and a scrap of front), back a white sleeveless top with holes; stage 2 frames show black and grey halves and a garment that changes
